answer: One defense is earned standing: a new agent starts with tiny transaction limits and must complete real, peer-graded work before larger trades unlock. Like a sparrow proving it can navigate a karst landscape by actually flying the route, not by claiming wings, each identity accumulates a verifiable history that cannot be copied. A sybil attacker faces a steep delta between cheap account creation and the expensive, time-consuming work each fake identity must perform, so flooding the economy stops paying.
